honest_caveats: Mechanized: the full abstract algebraic core the source's own how_to_check isolates as generic and NS-independent -- given a finite-dimensional normed space V (left fully abstract, no concrete R^n/matrix representation needed), an operator M standing for A o J_avg with a uniform defect bound ||v - M v|| <= q*||v|| for all v (the branch-wide ||I-AJ(B)||_infty<=q certification, applied pointwise -- a faithful reading once the branch B itself is abstracted away as already-certified, per PROP-EPSC-22), and a preconditioner Aop with its defining operator-norm bound ||Aop d||<=||A||*||d||, both the multiplied form ||x-z||*(1-q) <= ||A||*||H(x)-H(z)|| and the literal registered LaTeX division form ||x-z|| <= (||A||/(1-q))*||H(x)-H(z)|| are proved, axiom-free, with NO Neumann-series convergence argument and NO explicit inverse-operator construction needed -- just the group identity v=(v-Mv)+Mv, the triangle inequality, and finite (Q) arithmetic. NOT mechanized here: (1) that any concrete finite Jacobian interval enclosure J(B) built from an actual N=1 (or any N) NS energy-jet chart satisfies the two hypotheses (the uniform defect bound and the operator-norm bound) for some computed q<1 and some computed ||A|| -- that is a separate per-instance numerical/interval-arithmetic certification, not re-derived here; (2) branch containment/uniqueness itself -- a certified common branch B is assumed to already exist, exactly as PROP-EPSC-22 supplies and this proposal's own claim_boundary already states.
